notes: Expanded list poisoning prevention to all private IP ranges: — `isPrivateHost` now blocks `10.x.x.x`, `192.168.x.x`, and `172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255` in addition to loopback/localhost. Applied at every insertion point (scraping, deduplication, import, manual add). | Discovery Engine Intelligence Keyword input not focusable: — same race condition as Proxy Chains rename: the `useEffect` focus call ran before DOM render completed, and React's `autoFocus` sometimes lost to other render cycles. Added `setTimeout(50ms)` fallback to ensure focus lands after the panel renders. | SearXNG blocked by SSRF protection: — the configured SearXNG instance URL (typically a local private IP like `192.168.1.2`) was being rejected by SSRF protection. `validateURL()` now accepts a `bypassURLs` parameter, and `fetchWithEvasion()` automatically passes the configured SearXNG URL so it bypasses the SSRF check while all other private IPs remain blocked.
